question: Which of the following bills is NOT passed by both Houses. Parliament of India, during Winter Session: 29 November 2021 to 22 December 2021?

options.text: The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021
The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Amendment) Bill, 2021

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021.**__
